summary: Israeli passengers thwarted an attempted jihadist takeover of a FlyDubai flight from Dubai, subduing the co-pilot and landing safely at Ben Gurion after diversion to Saudi Arabia. IDF airstrikes in Gaza eliminated two Hamas operatives, including an October 7 infiltrator posing as a journalist and a platoon commander linked to Al Jazeera. The UK accused Iran of a foiled terrorist plot targeting RAF Fairford, a base supporting US operations against Iranian missile sites, while the US Treasury predicted Iran's economic collapse within two weeks.
key_points: Israeli passengers stormed the cockpit of a FlyDubai flight, subdued a suspect co-pilot, and regained control with assistance from an additional pilot, landing safely at Ben Gurion Airport. (Source: @New_security8200/204047)

IDF eliminated Hamas platoon commander Amar al-Sharafi in Gaza City and Oct 7 infiltrator Muhammad al-Najar in Khan Yunis, both accused of violating ceasefire and rebuilding terror capabilities. (Source: @idf_telegram/25255)

UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated strong evidence links Iran to a foiled terrorist plot targeting RAF Fairford, a base used for US operations against Iranian missile sites. (Source: @VahidOnline/78583)

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent assessed Iran's economy will have 'nothing to exchange' within two weeks due to naval blockade and sanctions, pushing Tehran toward a deal. (Source: @VahidOnline/78587)
Russian intelligence sources warned of an imminent surprise attack on Iran, while Trump hinted at upcoming events regarding Iran. (Source: @kianmeli1/92746)
A gas pipeline supplying the Tishreen Thermal Power Plant exploded near Damascus International Airport. (Source: @presstv/209001)
Red Alert Lebanon reported increased hostile drone activity in South Lebanon skies, with affected areas mapped. (Source: @redlinkleb/46051)
Turkish National Security Council warned of escalating global consequences from Iran-US clashes and called for immediate resumption of negotiations. (Source: @SharghDaily/186816)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli passengers thwarted an attempted jihadist takeover of a FlyDubai flight from Dubai, subduing the co-pilot and landing safely at Ben Gurion after diversion to Saudi Arabia. IDF airstrikes in Gaza eliminated two Hamas operatives, including an October 7 infiltrator posing as a journalist and a platoon commander linked to Al Jazeera. The UK accused Iran of a foiled terrorist plot targeting RAF Fairford, a base supporting US operations against Iranian missile sites, while the US Treasury predicted Iran's economic collapse within two weeks.

points: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated strong evidence links Iran to a foiled terrorist plot targeting RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire, a base used since March as a logistics hub for US strikes on Iranian missile sites threatening Hormuz shipping; five British suspects aged 23-25 were arrested but released on bail. (Source: @VahidOnline/78583)

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated Iran's economy under naval blockade will have 'nothing for trade' within two weeks after last oil shipments, with the dollar hitting record highs against the collapsing rial, pushing Tehran toward a deal. (Source: @VahidOnline/78587)

Russian security reporter cited intelligence sources warning of an imminent surprise attack on Iran; Trump separately promised 'you will soon witness events regarding Iran,' and Netanyahu told Bin Zayed Iran is preparing a ground attack from Azerbaijan. (Source: @kianmeli1/92746, @rodast_omiddana/81768)
Iranian troops in southern regions reportedly equipped with CBRN protection kits, indicating preparation for chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear threats. (Source: @shin_persian/10646)
Press TV analyst Sakina Datoo dismissed Fairford accusations as inconsistent and likely a false-flag operation to tarnish Iran's image. (Source: @presstv/209037)

FlyDubai flight FZ161 from Dubai signaled emergency; Israeli passengers confronted the co-pilot, tied him with headphones, and restored control to a backup pilot; plane diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, then landed safely at Ben Gurion. (Source: @New_security8200/204047, @manniefabian/59281, @pkpoi/144133)

Defense Minister Israel Katz declared the incident a thwarted jihadist terror attack aimed at crashing the plane, praising passenger heroism and emphasizing intelligence-based warnings. (Source: @New_security8200/204047)

Netanyahu spoke with UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed, who agreed to a joint investigation; Netanyahu also to speak with Trump; Israel had no prior intelligence on the hijacking attempt. (Source: @N12chat/227882, @New_security8200/204050)
IDF Southern Command forces deployed per ceasefire agreement, continuing operations to remove immediate threats in Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/25255)
Arkia, El Al, and Israir flights to UAE pending final Shin Bet approval; flight schedules being coordinated. (Source: @N12chat/227888)

IDF airstrike in Khan Yunis eliminated Muhammad Abdulaziz Muhammad Ngar, Hamas military operative who infiltrated Israel on Oct 7 and later posed as a journalist; he recently promoted terror plans and rebuilt Hamas capabilities violating ceasefire. (Source: @idf_telegram/25255)

IDF airstrike in Gaza City eliminated Amar Mahmoud Hamed Sharafi, Hamas platoon commander, brother of Al Jazeera journalist Moamen al-Sharafi; IDF stated he advanced terror plans and violated ceasefire. (Source: @N12chat/227881)
Both strikes used precise munitions and aerial surveillance to minimize civilian harm; IDF emphasized systematic ceasefire violations by Hamas. (Source: @idf_telegram/25255)
Hebrew media highlighted Al Jazeera-Hamas connection via Sharafi brothers, suggesting media-terror nexus. (Source: @amitsegal/65399)
Red Alert Lebanon mapping shows increased hostile drone activity in South Lebanon skies; red circles indicate number of affected areas, not drone count. (Source: @redlinkleb/46051)
Gas pipeline supplying Tishreen Thermal Power Plant exploded near Damascus International Airport; cause, casualties, and impact unspecified. (Source: @presstv/209001)
UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed agreed to joint investigation with Israel into FlyDubai incident; Netanyahu to speak with Trump. (Source: @N12chat/227882, @New_security8200/204050)

Turkish National Security Council warned Iran-US clashes create regional security vulnerabilities and called for immediate negotiations, labeling conflict a 'cycle of destruction.' (Source: @SharghDaily/186816)
Arkia, El Al, and Israir preparing flights to UAE pending Shin Bet approval
